_comment: Three discussion tasks of similar length and difficulty. The SAME script is used in every condition; only the robot's participation behaviour changes. Topics are open-ended (no right answer) so that every participant can contribute regardless of subject knowledge. Topic-to-condition pairing is counterbalanced by 'python -m nuru plan'.

greeting.en: Hello everyone, my name is Nuru. Today we will discuss a few questions together. There are no right or wrong answers, and you can always choose to pass.

closing.en: Thank you all for sharing your ideas. Asanteni sana.

T1.title: School water project
T1.intro: Imagine your school has received money for one project to improve access to clean water.
questions: Which project should the school choose, and why?
Who in the community should be involved in the decision?
What problems might the project face, and how could you solve them?
How would you know, after one year, that the project was a success?

T2.title: Planning a class trip
T2.intro: Imagine your class can go on a one-day trip anywhere within your country.
questions: Where should the class go, and why?
What should students learn during the trip?
How can the trip be made affordable for every family?
What rules should the class agree on before leaving?

T3.title: A better school library
T3.intro: Imagine your school wants to make its library a place that more students use.
questions: What would make students want to visit the library more often?
Which books or materials should be added first?
Should the library have books in local languages? Why or why not?
How could older students help younger students to read?
